items.titleZh: OpenAI 的新代理是对 Meta 的一次尝试——但它能与免费代理竞争吗？
items.titleEn: OpenAI’s new agent is a shot at Meta — but can it compete with free?
items.summaryZh: The Verge AI 报道了人工智能领域的产品开发。消息来源的关键点：在 OpenAI 的年度 DevDay 大会上，该公司使出浑身解数与竞争对手竞争——主要是 Meta，其 Muse AI 代理平台已经取得了早期的巨大成功。
items.summaryEn: The Verge AI reports a product development in AI. Key point from the source: At OpenAI's annual DevDay conference, the company pulled out all the stops to compete with its rivals - primarily Meta, whose Muse AI agent platform has seen early runaway success.
items.overviewZh: The Verge AI 发布了一篇关于“OpenAI 的新代理是对 Meta 的一次尝试——但它能与免费竞争吗？”的最新更新。

items.titleEn: OpenAI cuts ties with 3 safety researchers, WSJ reports

items.titleZh: 帮助小型企业将人工智能发挥作用
items.titleEn: Helping small businesses put AI to work
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 博客报道了人工智能的行业发展。消息来源的要点：OpenAI 正在与美国 SBDC 合作，扩大对小型企业的人工智能实践培训和本地支持，同时发布一份关于小型团队如何使用人工智能的新报告。
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Blog reports an industry development in AI. Key point from the source: OpenAI is partnering with America’s SBDC to expand hands-on AI training and local support for small businesses, alongside a new report on how small teams are using AI.
items.overviewZh: OpenAI 博客发布了有关“帮助小型企业将人工智能运用到工作中”的最新更新。
